name: Lens Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Lens Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of structural components, functional modules, complete machine assembly, and other supporting services in China and internationally. The company offers front and rear glass cover; stainless steel, space aluminum, magnesium-aluminum alloy, titanium alloy, and other new composite materials; metal; sapphire; ceramics; plastics molds; other materials; and protective panels, fingerprint modules, touch modules, biometrics, and other appearance structures.
